findings.summary: One assertion in the expired-metadata outage test is near-tautological.
findings.detail: Phase6OutageTests.OutageAfterTheStaleWindowDoesNotKeepOrUseExpiredMetadataAndLeavesArtworkUnchanged passes 'metadataUsable: false' to ArtworkRegenerationPlanner.Decide and then asserts ShouldGenerate is false; Decide short-circuits on !metadataUsable (ArtworkRegenerationPlanner.cs line 72), so this assertion cannot fail independently. The category is still genuinely covered: the test also asserts the durable snapshot is Expired and not usable-as-current, and that no render or image save occurs with the artwork unchanged, which is the real fail-closed path. A stronger form would pass the actual IsUsableAsCurrent result rather than the literal. No change required.
